text:
nina.cs: Heads-up  EchoHealth (acquired AlderTech) renewal running into PO/vendor code mismatch. AlderTech PO is open but EchoHealth wants invoices under EchoHealth Inc.
leo.sales: Short version: customer asks consolidated billing under EchoHealth legal entity; procurement will only sign if PO matches vendor code + invoice shows line-item mapping.
anya.legal: We can accept an entity substitution addendum. Draft will state: "Redwood will apply existing purchase orders issued to AlderTech to EchoHealth Inc. upon execution of this addendum, without modifying pricing or service terms." Need legal names + tax IDs.
maria.ops: If we change billing entity for Dedicated capacity, check tenant/KMS mapping. Operations can keep provisioning on schedule if invoicing change is purely billing.
kevin.enable: Onboarding for AlderTech seats begins next week. If AP holds signing, we risk delaying onboarding by a sprint. Need invoice sample asap.
nina.cs: Action: (1) Anya draft addendum, (2) Leo get full legal name + tax ID + AP contact, (3) Maria create invoice sample with PO field + account line items, (4) Kevin track onboarding risk. Target: 48 hours.
anya.legal: Draft posted to /shared/legal/drafts. Kept to one paragraph. I'll include acceptance clause + signature block for EchoHealth and Redwood.
leo.sales: Customer provided vendor code ECHO-9001 and AP contact ap@echohealth.com (contact: Priya Shah, Dir Finance). They said PO will be issued once invoice sample includes PO# and existing AlderTech account IDs.
maria.ops: Uploaded invoice sample: sample_invoice_echohealth.pdf. Includes fields: invoice#, billing entity, tax id, PO#, per-account lines. No tenant change indicated.
nina.cs: Leo, once PO arrives open DocuSign with Anya's addendum and attach invoice sample. Tag me to counter-sign.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_echo_9001). Signers: Priya Shah (external), Redwood CS (nina.cs). Link: https://docusign.example/env_echo_9001
leo.sales: Sent envelope to Priya. She replied asking for confirmation that net30 remains and that seat counts/pricing unchanged.
anya.legal: Legal confirms addendum explicitly preserves pricing and term. No further signatures needed beyond the two signers.
kevin.enable: Customer acknowledged they will sign within 48 hours if PO# is visible on invoice. Onboarding to proceed on receipt of signed addendum + PO. If not, we'll pause provisioning on 2025-06-16.
leo.sales: Priya just shared tentative PO: PO-EHC-1122. Asked us to show PO on invoice before signing.
maria.ops: Attached updated invoice PDF reflecting PO-EHC-1122. Also included mapping of AlderTech account IDs to line items.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope updated (env_echo_9001) with attachment PO-EHC-1122.pdf. Status: sent to Priya Shah.
leo.sales: Priya confirmed and signed. DocuSign status: completed.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope completed (env_echo_9001). Signed by Priya Shah and nina.cs.
anya.legal: Received executed addendum. Quick note: if the original AlderTech PO date precedes 90 days of service start we may need to issue a small credit memo. Finance to advise.
nina.cs: Closing notes: onboarding greenlit upon receipt of signed addendum + PO. Kevin, proceed with provisioning. Maria, coordinate any billing/cycle adjustments with finance. Thanks team. :tada:
